canonical.rules: RFC 8785 JCS: sorted keys by code point, no whitespace, integers only, NO booleans in hash-bearing records (encode as string enums), NFC/LF for legal text

derives_from: all artifact ids and digests (never bundle_id)

crypto.builder_backend: libsodium 1.0.18 (soname libsodium.so.23, ABI 10.3), via ctypes — real version from sodium_version_string(), not the soname
crypto.independence: the two VERIFIERS use genuinely different vetted backends (pure-Go crypto/ed25519 vs Node/OpenSSL); the BUILDER signs with a third (libsodium). No homemade primitive is in any trusted path. Go and Node are two independent N-version IMPLEMENTATIONS from one specification — NOT an independent organizational audit.
crypto.verifier_a_backend: Go stdlib crypto/ed25519 (pure Go, filippo edwards25519 — NOT OpenSSL)

dag_rule: every reference points to an object earlier in construction_order; no back edge; no node contains its own id in its preimage. dag_check.py verifies this mechanically over the fixtures.
id_rule: each *_id = prefix + hex(sha256(id_domain 0x1F canonical(BODY))) where BODY EXCLUDES the id, the signature, any detached time attestation, any release_root, and any inclusion proof. An id that appears in its own preimage is a self-referential-id defect.

legal_relation_verbs.note: correction #15: a deterministic parser certifies only structural `cites`. Treatment verbs need anchored evidence + reviewer adoption, or an authentic official structured disposition.

merkle.release_leaf_data: UTF-8 bytes of the claim_id string, leaves ordered by ascending claim_id
merkle.unbalanced: split at largest power of two < n; NO duplicate-last

note: Shared, immutable contract read by BOTH independent verifiers (Go, Node) and the builder. Verifiers share ONLY this file plus the fixtures — never verification code. This is the corrected, ACYCLIC MLTP v3 core: no object embeds its own id in its preimage; time and release/inclusion are DETACHED (see construction_order).

profile_manifest.note: C1.1: signed manifest pinning the verification profile. Both verifiers reject a changed/downgraded/unknown schema or profile with untrusted-profile. Dev override (env MLTP_DEV_OVERRIDE=1) may proceed but NEVER returns VERIFIED (caps at UNKNOWN, reason profile-override-active).

result_rule: bundle result = min over all claim results, certified-result results, and bundle-level checks, by result_order (lower index = weaker).
sig_rule: sig = Ed25519(secret, context 0x1F canonical(object without its own sig field)). Wrong context => sig-invalid (domain-separation replay defence).

time_attestation.imprint: target_sig_imprint = sha256(hex) of the raw 64-byte signature bytes of the attested object
time_attestation.note: DETACHED (correction #2): signs the message-imprint of an object's signature, never sits inside the object's signed fields. This is a deterministic TEST DOUBLE of an RFC 3161 TSR with the SAME verification contract — it is NOT an actual TSR. A real DER RFC-3161 token (OpenSSL ts) lives in interop/rfc3161/token.tsr (C1.4).
time_attestation.rfc3161_semantics: correction #10: gen_time is trusted evidence the imprint existed AT-OR-BEFORE (gen_time + accuracy). t_sig upper bound = gen_time + accuracy; the signing key's delegation window is checked conservatively against this bound.
